ordered_parameters.name: attn_mask
ordered_parameters.type: optional boolean or additive attention mask

semantics.rust_signature: fn sageattn_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, shape: AttentionShape, q: &[f32], k: &[f32], v: &[f32], attn_mask: Option<AttentionMask>, is_causal: bool, tensor_layout: AttentionLayout, device: DeviceId, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Vec<f32>, AttentionKernelError>
semantics.mutation_rule: out-of-place; q, k, v, and attn_mask remain immutable
semantics.alias_rule: returns fresh owned storage that aliases no input or mask
semantics.shape_rule: q is BxNqxHxD or BxHxNqxD, k is BxNkxHxD or BxHxNkxD, v uses Dv, masks use checked key, query-key, batch-query-key, or batch-head-query-key shapes, and output follows q layout with Dv
semantics.dtype_rule: the deterministic exact native fallback accepts f32 inputs plus boolean or f32 additive masks
semantics.accumulation_dtype: f32 scores, softmax, and value accumulation
semantics.layout_rule: typed NHD and HND logical layouts are accepted and preserved
semantics.device_rule: CPU exact native fallback; non-CPU execution requires a separately certified adapter and returns typed unavailable here
semantics.numeric_rule: scaled dot product with max-subtracted softmax, broadcast mask application, and bottom-right aligned causal masking
semantics.tolerance: absolute 0.000001 for checked f32 forward fixtures and 0.0003 for finite-difference gradients
semantics.determinism: fixed loop order with no stochastic path
semantics.cancellation_points: before allocation and once per batch-head-query row; cancellation publishes no output
semantics.vjp_rule: analytical softmax attention VJP for q, k, and v with mask values treated as constants
semantics.jvp_rule: analytical softmax attention JVP for q, k, and v verified against finite differences and the VJP adjoint
